craft_notes: Sthāyin: Courage of refuge (utsāha). Question-dash→comma (ground sued softly, whole sued). Rejected: 'aye' for 'for ever' — L3 kept. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Eight-bodied, wilt in a single body ground us
for ever, or gladdened, grant the whole?
l4.sanskrit_cite: aṣṭamūrte kim ekasyām api mūrtau na naḥ sthitim śāśvatīṃ kuruṣe yad vā tuṣṭaḥ sarvaṃ kariṣyasi

reads_against.argmap: O eight-formed, in even one form will you not make eternal standing for us. → Make eternal standing in one form; pleased, do all.
c1_essence: Chant-sung thought-blaze urged straight; eight-bodied asked for lasting ground or all.

l2.plain_english: Eight-bodied one — in one body at least, grant us ground that holds; or glad-hearted, grant us everything.
l2.sanskrit_cite: aṣṭamūrte kim ekasyām api mūrtau na naḥ sthitim śāśvatīṃ kuruṣe yad vā tuṣṭaḥ sarvaṃ kariṣyasi

l3: Eight-bodied, wilt in a single body ground us
